name: stable-diffusion-webui

SD_WEBUI_HOST.description: Host:port of a running Automatic1111 server (must be started with --api). Defaults to 127.0.0.1:7860.

SD_WEBUI_API_BASE.description: Full API base URL. Overrides SD_WEBUI_HOST for hosted/HTTPS deployments.

SD_WEBUI_AUTH.description: HTTP basic auth in 'user:pass' form when the WebUI was started with --api-auth.

OUTPUT_DIR.description: Directory to write generated images into. Defaults to ./output.

notes: Wraps a running Automatic1111 server via its REST API. ADVISOR tier — generated outputs are previewed before write-out (image gen burns GPU time and queue space). The adapter does not spawn the server. License is AGPL-3.0 — copyleft for the WebUI itself; review before bundling into closed deployments.
